cases.question: What is the Direct-plan expense ratio?

cases.question: What is the benchmark?
cases.actual: Benchmark: NIFTY India Defence Index TRI (Total Returns Index). As of 2026-09-30 [factsheet page 29](https://files.hdfcfund.com/s3fs-public/2026-10/HDFC%20MF%20Factsheet%20-%20September%202026.pdf?VersionId=xjdQxQp4UEchOirw4TsCE9jEGenOREzw#page=29).

cases.question: What is the exit load?
cases.actual: Exit load: 0.5% within 90 days of allotment; nil on or after 90 days. Applies to redemption and switch-out.. As of 2026-09-30 [factsheet page 20](https://www.kotakmf.com/kotakflipbook/docs/download/sep2026#page=20).

cases.question: What is the exit load?
cases.actual: Exit load: 1% on or before 15 days from allotment; nil after 15 days. Applies to switches between schemes; no load between options within the scheme or from Regular to Direct within the same scheme.. As of 2026-08-31 [factsheet page 5](https://www.motilaloswalmf.com/content/dam/motilal-mf/downloads/mf/factsheet/2026/sep/Factsheet%20August%202026%20Passive.pdf#page=5).
